decisions.conflict: Legacy v1 platform/provider/runtime declarations compete with shipped web, Mobile and Hetzner.
decisions.resolution: Mark specs.yaml historical; retain original content as provenance. Domain source applicability still needs reconciliation.

decisions.conflict: README promises durable offline booking synchronization not established by pinned Mobile implementation.
decisions.resolution: Remove unsupported promise; current in-memory query caching is not booking acceptance. No offline queue was silently added.

decisions.conflict: Historical verification receipts could be mistaken for current-main evidence.
decisions.resolution: Archive the previous audit and preserve its scope; current results require exact candidate execution.

decisions.conflict: Mobile guidance says no automated tests despite configured Jest suite.
decisions.resolution: Correct guidance; require actual Mobile quality gate and exact gitlink.

decisions.conflict: Old backend guidance describes obsolete runtime/deployment and test assumptions.
decisions.resolution: Retain Stack-pinned compiler as build authority; observed deployment identity overrides obsolete provider prose. Canonical routine-release completion remains open.

decisions.conflict: Observed production reflects arbitrary origins with credentials, contrary to the intended authentication/privacy boundary.
decisions.resolution: Fix middleware and production configuration; do not redefine arbitrary credentialed sharing as intended behavior.

decisions.conflict: Video-source settings route lacks an entry in the canonical feature registry.
decisions.resolution: Add admin.video-sources using inspected backend strict-admin/module guard and explicit Mobile concealment.

decisions.conflict: Mobile main d2fd9399126e3b456c310497fb7d9edba09f981d contains newer payment flows and contract additions not shipped by root baseline b07f67c3ebe2022d5f70e94578944b6401616696.
decisions.resolution: Explicit user decision 2026-10-04: keep shipped Mobile lineage. Audit and compatibility patch descend from ede1f2a0ccf75f3794c7892f291e1751b279d19e; do not integrate unrelated newer Mobile payment flows.

decisions.conflict: Legacy signup treated supplied matching or absent artist email as verified ownership; session helper committed outer credential mutations before issuing tokens.
decisions.resolution: Reject anonymous artist adoption; route independent accounts to reviewed management. Serialize credential transitions and remove the read-only token-reuse/early-commit behavior. This is a security repair, not specification approval of existing bugs.
